evidence: infra/autolander/land.py:278: `timeout_s=(WAIT_TIMEOUT_S if args.wait else 0),`
infra/autolander/land.py:160: `if clock() - start >= timeout_s:` followed by `return (TIMED_OUT, {})`
Inline comment lines 266-269 claims a no-wait land 'returns as soon as an outcome is known', which contradicts the timeout=0 behavior (it returns TIMED_OUT, not a real outcome)
ABSENCE: no test exercises main() or the no-wait land path (search for `land.main` in tests returned no matches)
advisory.finding: `land <change>` without `--wait` sets `Autosubmit` and then immediately returns `timed_out` (exit 124) for any not-yet-terminal change, because main() passes `timeout_s=0` and land()'s loop check `clock() - start >= timeout_s` is satisfied (~0 >= 0) on the first non-terminal poll.
scenarios: Agent runs `land <change>` (fire-and-forget, no --wait) on an in-progress change: Autosubmit is set, but the command reports timed_out (exit 124) instead of e.g. pending/a real outcome.

evidence: infra/autolander/land.py:179: `native = gerrit.get_change(change, ["DETAILED_LABELS"])` (no try/except)
land() wraps the same call: infra/autolander/land.py:148-153 `except Exception ... if errors >= 3: return (ERROR, ...)` — land_status has no equivalent
docs/land-contract.md: 'Every exit code is pinned — there is no "any nonzero" hole.' and `error | 7 | Any other failure (bounded transport retries exhausted, etc.)`
gerrit.py raises GerritError on non-2xx / URLError (infra/autolander/gerrit.py:64-65, 90-91)
ABSENCE: test_s4_land_held_out.py has no land_status transport-error case
advisory.finding: `land_status()` calls `gerrit.get_change(...)` with no error handling, so an unreachable or erroring Gerrit raises an uncaught exception that escapes main(), producing a Python traceback and process exit 1 (colliding with needs_rebase) instead of the contract's pinned `error` (exit 7).
scenarios: `land-status <change>` when the Gerrit API is unreachable or returns 5xx: uncaught exception -> traceback, exit 1 (misread as needs_rebase).

scenarios: Agent without S1's requester-votable ACL runs `land`: set_review 403 -> uncaught GerritError -> traceback + exit 1 instead of the pinned `error` (7).
